name: Borde de Arena — Pared Horizontal
generation_strategy: 1 imagen 1024×1024. Se recorta a tamaño de juego. La versión vertical se deriva rotando 90°.

frames.role: Borde horizontal de la arena — indestructible, las balas rebotan
frames.prompt: Cartoon arena boundary wall segment sprite, viewed strictly from directly above at 90 degrees (bird's eye zenith view, only TOP FACE visible), isolated on transparent background. STYLE: vibrant warm cartoon game art, Brawl Stars quality. A thick chunky horizontal rectangle — clearly heavier and more imposing than the destructible player walls. Warm dark stone/concrete color (#555550 dark charcoal-gray with warm undertone), surface has bold cartoon reinforcement details visible from above: parallel bolt/rivet rows along the length, 2-3 recessed panel lines, chunky solid feel. The inner long edge (top of rectangle in image) has bold yellow-black diagonal cartoon hazard stripes — a warning band clearly indicating the boundary. Bold dark charcoal outline. Chunky, solid, indestructible-looking. NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, thin, fragile, blue glow, neon sci-fi, text, watermark, background scenery, complex details

phaser_config.positions: bordes superior e inferior de la arena
phaser_config.notes: Las balas rebotan en estos bordes. Indestructibles. border-wall-v se deriva rotando 90°.
